notes.title: Gummy Goo Clean Up Is CANCELED Unfortunately!
notes.notes: I have already announced this on the channel, but this is the official post that unfortunately Gummy Goo Clean Up is CANCELED for good. Game coding for a full game is just not something I want to do. It has taken me trying this for a while to realize that. Also, the livestreams for development were not very popular so that kinda ruined it too. Again I'm sorry and hope you understand.

notes.title: The Goo Update Alpha 0.5 is HERE!
notes.notes:
///****** The Goo Update Alpha 0.5 ******///

The Goo update is finally here. Now there is an inside level with 4 new parts of Tony The Tutorial boy teaching you about some new Goo stuff. You can clean that gooey goo with your new mop. And we even have different sounds for the atmosphere and ground. And oh wait we got doors. Yup. You can use doors to get to areas not accessible otherwise. So enjoy Level 2 with 3 parts and get ready for the next update.

- 6 New Trash Items Added
- The Mop added as a new weapon
- Puddles to clean for fun added
- THE GOO Added
- Goo Drippers with levers to turn on and off added
- Doors that lead to different areas added
- Level 2 (Inside Area) Added with 3 parts
- 4 New Tony The Tutorial Boy parts Added with Geo's voice
- Level Select System so you can replay any level again...and again.... AND AGAIN!
- Almost full controller support: Now you can use the controller and keyboard mouse at the same time.
- Removed screen resolution for now
- Goo count now added to UI Box in Level 2
- Credits screen added that can be accessed from the main menu

- Lots of bugs and fixes and improvements
- Dev mode improved with a UI Box added
